title: Review Round 3 — verification of the v3 update
intro: I verified the v3 changes including reading the referenced tickets end-to-end. **9 of 11 items are closed and verified:** Staff ID immutability + normalization (AC1), unmatched-code decision (AC4), migration decision (IA2), first-wins precedence (AC4), permission separation per portal + ACP-257 (AC7/IA4), checker-time re-validation (AC10.5), Assigned To column/detail/audit entry (AC9), QR dropped for phase 1, mockup renamed.
**Two P1 blockers remain — both introduced by how the fixes were wired. Not Ready for Dev until these close.**

cells: Round-robin reuses QUEUE assignment — wrong mechanism
AC4 mechanism 2 + IA2 reuse ACP-18 AC1 as-is. ACP-18 triggers when an application drops into a manual-review queue, its pool is processors, and it writes the queue's Assigned To.

Sales round-robin is its own mechanism: trigger at origination when no code; pool = active users WITH a Staff ID per channel/product; output = the Staff ID attribution, never the queue's Assigned To. Keep ACP-18 as algorithm precedent only.
Case reassignment is required but impossible
AC8 IEM004 blocks deactivation until cases are reassigned, but AC4 declares attribution immutable and no AC defines a reassignment function.
Add a permission-gated, maker/checker "Reassign Case (Sale Staff)" function with an audit entry; reword AC4 immutability to "changes only via explicit reassignment".

sections.heading: Minor items to close in the same edit:
numbered: Unmatched-code cases die silently — add an ET51-style alert or an "Untagged — unmatched code" report view.
AC4 preamble says "first mechanism that produces a valid match" but an unmatched code still blocks mechanism 2 — reword to match the carve-out.
AC7 still says "define which roles receive this permission at migration" while IA2 grants ALL existing enquiry users — align the two.

closing: → Close P1-A and P1-B, then we move this to Ready for Dev.
